rule.statement: A proclamation under the Rent Restriction Ordinance is required to be made to bring an area under the operation of the Rent Act.
rule.supporting_quote: In the absence of a fresh proclamation made either under the Rent Restriction Ordinance declaring Jaffna Municipal limits under the said Ordinance or under section 2 (1) (b) of the Rent Restriction Act No. 29 of 1948, the learned Counsel for the Respondent argued that the provisions of the Rent Act No.7 of 1972 has no application with regard to the premises in question before us.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Rent Restriction Ordinance No.60 of 1942, Section 2 (1)
